en.title: Minimum Arbitrary Swaps to Put Even Numbers First
en.description:
One operation swaps the elements at any two indices. All even numbers must come before all odd numbers. Neither group needs to be sorted internally, and swaps are not limited to adjacent elements.

The input/output protocol and the explicitly marked supplementary constraints were compiled by this site; upstream solutions are not executed.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains positive integers. The original text gives no numeric bounds; this site uses 1≤n≤200000 and 1≤element≤10⁹.
en.output: Output the single integer required by the problem.
en.explanation: The answers to the three public examples are, in order: 1; 2; 0. The examples were rechecked by independent enumeration, state search, or direct simulation.
hints: First count the number of even numbers e; the number of odd numbers among the first e positions is the answer.
